#!/bin/bash

# 获取token
echo "=== 获取登录token ==="
TOKEN=$\(curl -s 'http://localhost:8085/api/develop/auth/login' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"123456"}' | jq -r '.token'\)

if [ -z "$TOKEN" ] || [ "$TOKEN" = "null" ]; then
  echo "❌ 登录失败，尝试通过Gateway"
  # 尝试通过gateway获取token
  TOKEN=$\(curl -s 'http://localhost:8000/api/system/auth/login' \\
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
    -d '{"username":"admin","password":"123456"}' | jq -r '.token'\)
fi

echo "Token: $TOKEN"

# 执行任务12
echo -e "\\n=== 执行任务12 ==="
EXEC_RESULT=$\(curl -s "http://localhost:8085/api/develop/items/12/execute" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -X POST \\
  -d '{}'\)

echo "$EXEC_RESULT" | jq '.'

# 提取execution_id
EXECUTION_ID=$\(echo "$EXEC_RESULT" | jq -r '.execution_id'\)
echo -e "\\n执行ID: $EXECUTION_ID"

# 等待执行完成
echo -e "\\n=== 等待执行完成（最多60秒）==="
for i in {1..60}; do
  sleep 1
  STATUS=$\(curl -s "http://localhost:8085/api/develop/executions/$EXECUTION_ID" \\
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq -r '.status'\)
  PROGRESS=$\(curl -s "http://localhost:8085/api/develop/executions/$EXECUTION_ID" \\
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq -r '.progress'\)
  
  echo "[$i秒] 状态: $STATUS, 进度: $PROGRESS%"
  
  if [ "$STATUS" = "success" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "failed" ]; then
    break
  fi
done

# 查看完整结果
echo -e "\\n=== 执行详情 ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:8085/api/develop/executions/$EXECUTION_ID" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq '{
    status: .status,
    progress: .progress,
    current_step: .current_step,
    has_result: \(.result != null\),
    has_inputs: \(.inputs != null\),
    has_logs: \(.result.logs != null\),
    execution_time_ms: .execution_time_ms
  }'

echo -e "\\n=== 查看inputs字段 ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:8085/api/develop/executions/$EXECUTION_ID" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq '.inputs'

echo -e "\\n=== 查看日志数量 ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:8085/api/develop/executions/$EXECUTION_ID" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq '.result.logs | length'
EOF)
